name: com.vertar/vertar
title: Vertar
description: Performance and prestige cars for sale at UK dealers, with asking prices and market figures.

tools.name: search_cars
tools.description: Find individual cars for sale at UK dealers: use this when the person wants cars (a make, model or version, a budget, a year, mileage, gearbox, body, near a place or in a region). All filters are optional and combine. Returns the total matching and up to 20 cars, each with its price, year, mileage, dealer, town, region, miles away (when `near` is given) and its vertar.com link. For one car in full use get_car; for typical prices and trends use market_summary; for a list of dealers use find_dealers.

price_min.description: Lowest asking price in GBP, e.g. 50000

price_max.description: Highest asking price in GBP, e.g. 150000

near.description: A UK town, city, postcode or postcode district, e.g. "Leeds", "Bath", "GU22", "SW1A 1AA"

within_miles.description: Only within this many miles of `near`

region.description: One of the UK's regions: London, South East England, South West England, East of England, East Midlands, West Midlands, Yorkshire, North West England, North East England, Wales, Scotland, Northern Ireland

text.description: Free text matched against the title, e.g. "Weissach"

sort.description: With `near`, nearest first unless another order is given

limit.description: How many cars to return, 1 to 20 (default 10)

tools.name: get_car
tools.description: Everything about one car already found with search_cars (or from a vertar.com/for-sale/ link): its key facts, the maker's official figures, its asking-price history, a short summary and its dealer. Use it when the person asks about a particular car.

slug.description: The car's vertar.com/for-sale/ URL as search_cars gives it (`url`), or the slug at its end

tools.name: market_summary
tools.description: Market figures for a make, model or version across UK dealers, not individual cars: use it for "what does a … cost", "are prices falling" or "how fast do they sell". Returns Vertar’s checked daily figures: cars for sale, median, lowest and highest asking price, the 30- and 90-day price trend, sold in the last 30 and 90 days, days to sell, price cuts, mileage, and each figure as a dated sentence to quote. A figure is null when its sample is too small.

model.description: Model line, e.g. "720S"; leave out for the whole make

variant.description: The version, e.g. "Spider"; leave out for the whole model

tools.name: find_dealers
tools.description: Dealers, not cars: use it when the person asks which dealers or specialists sell a make, or which are near a place or in a region. Returns each dealer with how many cars it has for sale (of that make, when given), its town, region, miles away (when `near` is given) and its vertar.com page. To see the cars themselves, pass a dealer's `slug` to search_cars as `dealer`.

make.description: Only dealers with this make for sale, e.g. "Aston Martin"

near.description: A UK town, city, postcode or postcode district, e.g. "Leeds", "Bath", "GU22", "SW1A 1AA"

within_miles.description: Only within this many miles of `near`

region.description: One of the UK's regions: London, South East England, South West England, East of England, East Midlands, West Midlands, Yorkshire, North West England, North East England, Wales, Scotland, Northern Ireland

location.description: Text matched against the dealer's town, e.g. "Knutsford" (prefer `near` or `region`)
